Chapter 7147: Celestial Immortal’S Method

Chapter 7147: Celestial Immortal’s Method

“Not bad at all, and ample room for growth.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Of course, Tortoise Immortal said Lil’ Dragon can reach atavism.” She said excitedly.

Li Qiye glanced at the dragon hiding behind the princess.

“Come, Lil’ Dragon, come meet the young noble.” She pushed it forward.

The dragon was afraid due to its powerful bloodline capable of detecting Li Qiye’s danger.

“Keep training, your gift will manifest even more.” Li Qiye patted the dragon repeatedly. With each pat, more stars appeared in arrays.

They appeared real enough to form cosmic beasts, wanting to fly out of the dragon’s body. It sensed the mysteries of the stars and roared in response.

“Your blood is yours, focus on it, no need for atavism.” Li Qiye said.

It appreciated the advice and after digesting it, it lay down next to his feet.

“That’s unfair, Young Noble, grant me a fortune too.” She pouted.

“Your fortune is staying here in Worldbearer Firmament.” Li Qiye smiled.

“This place?” She asked softly: “It can still stick around?”

“Of course.” Li Qiye glanced at the solid mass and said: “It’s a place of fortune, that’s why the divine beasts chose it.”

“Very well, I will listen.” She nodded.

The firmament was more than happy to have her and the dragon stay. After all, there was no one to inherit Worldbearer Tortoise’s legacy.

Li Qiye then focused on the new mass.

“You wish to go there, Sir?” Apex asked.

“Can’t leave empty-handed since I’m already here.” Li Qiye said.

“We wish to contribute what we can.” Apex and Hao Cai offered.

“No need, I alone am enough.” Li Qiye said before flying into the sky.

***

The sea of wisdom was mysterious. Some believed this was the birthplace of the divine beasts. Another said it was the final resting place of Skykiller True Dragon, hence the many phenomena.

A small number viewed it as an ominous location, potentially the source of many terrible events.

All in all, it resembled a massive square planet now. The divine beasts have entered and taken on an unknown form. It appeared to be solid and impenetrable.

Apex and Hao Cai remained curious and didn’t run. Although Li Qiye didn’t need them, they could still watch. Moreover, being near him was the safest choice.

They knocked on the solid surface and exchanged glances.

“Impossible.” They concluded that this would take millions of years for them to get through.

“A celestial immortal’s method.” Hao Cai whispered.

“Not just that, this is someone with apex power or greater.” Apex said.

“Only Heavenfall then.” Hao Cai said.

“Hidden Immortal, Octopus.” Apex shook his head and added two mysterious beings.

As for Li Qiye, he finally pushed the solid sea.

“Rumble!” The Divine Firmament shook violently, as if split into two halves.

Li Qiye continued pushing like a mortal pushing a fence, not releasing any dao power. Hao Cai and Apex couldn’t believe how he was doing it effortlessly.

They realized that Divine Firmament or even Heavenrealm was only a small ant nest to him.

After opening a path, he jumped inside without worrying about an ambush. The duo exchanged glances; a contest between curiosity and fear ensued.

They finally decided to jump in, curious about the mastermind.

Meanwhile, everyone else was also curious about the sea of wisdom.

“What is in there?” An overlord murmured.

“The person behind everything.” A dragon servant said softly, still frustrated that their masters had another master.
